_readme: Copy this file to config.json and fill in all values. GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT stored here — set it as an environment variable. restoreTestRepo is OPTIONAL — only consumed by `npm run verify:phase-4`; safe to leave as the placeholder until you want to verify restore correctness. webhookHostname is REQUIRED — operator must point an A record at the droplet IP before `npm run bootstrap-droplet`. webhookTestRepo is OPTIONAL — only consumed by `npm run verify:phase-3`.
